**LED GREETING CARD**

&nbsp;

**Description**

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;

An LED greeting card is a handmade greeting card that combines creative paper design with a simple electronic circuit. An LED is connected to a small power source and placed inside the card to produce a glowing light.

&nbsp;

**Material Required**

&nbsp;

Chart paper,LED,coil cell,aluminium battery,tape,glue,colour paper,sketch pen,decorative materials

&nbsp;

**Procedure**&nbsp;

&nbsp;

1.Take a sheet of paper and fold it to form a greeting card.

2.Design and decorate the front side of the card using color paper and craft materials.

3\. Decide the position of the LED on the card.

4.Place the LED in the required position.

5.Cut the thin strips of aluminium foil and use them as conducting paths.

6.Connect the aluminium foil strips between the LED and the coil cell.

7.Fix the foil properly using the tape and glue.

8.Add a simple contact arrangement to complete the circuit.

9.Test the circuit and check whether the LED glows.

10.Write the greeting message and complete the decoration.&nbsp;

&nbsp;

**Notes**

&nbsp;

1.Connect the LED to the coin cell with the correct polarity.

2.Use aluminium foil as the conducting path between the LED and coin cell.

3.Fix the aluminium foil firmly so that the connection remains intact.

4.Secure the coin cell properly inside the greeting card.

5.Make sure the circuit is arranged neatly and does not affect the opening and closing of the card.

6.Check the connection properly to ensure that the LED glows when the circuit is completed.
